questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of brainstorming when coming up with side hustle ideas?

options.text: To immediately pick the best idea and start working on it
To generate as many ideas as possible without judging them at first
To criticize and eliminate bad ideas right away
To create a detailed business plan for one ideaCorrect Answer:B) To generate as many ideas as possible without judging them at first

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an effective way to identify problems in your community that could inspire a side hustle?

options.text: Ignoring complaints because they’re not your responsibility
Only focusing on problems that affect adults in your area
Observing daily frustrations at school or in your neighborhood and asking others what bugs them
Waiting for someone else to solve local issues before starting a businessCorrect Answer:C) Observing daily frustrations at school or in your neighborhood and asking others what bugs them

questions.question_text: How can social media polls help in researching a side hustle idea?

options.text: They provide a way to quickly get feedback from peers about the demand for your idea
They are only useful for advertising your product after you start selling
They help you design a logo for your business
They automatically tell you how much profit you’ll makeCorrect Answer:A) They provide a way to quickly get feedback from peers about the demand for your idea

questions.question_text: What is the benefit of conducting a competitor analysis for your side hustle?

options.text: It helps you copy exactly what others are doing to guarantee success
It allows you to learn from others’ strengths and weaknesses to find your unique angle
It discourages you from starting a business if others are already doing something similar
It focuses only on criticizing other businesses without improving your own ideaCorrect Answer:B) It allows you to learn from others’ strengths and weaknesses to find your unique angle

questions.question_text: Why is a feasibility check important before starting a side hustle as a teen?

options.text: It ensures you’ll make a lot of money right away
It helps you decide if you have the time, resources, and skills to make the idea work with your busy schedule
It guarantees that your idea will never fail
It focuses only on getting permission from parents to start a businessCorrect Answer:B) It helps you decide if you have the time, resources, and skills to make the idea work with your busy schedule
